conviction_note: Nothing decisive: no pre-release this October (unlike 2019-2024), H1 landed within 0.5% of plan last year and Q1 progress mirrors last year, so the H1 most likely prints on plan with the full-year plan held, no new buyback (2bn programme still running to Jan 2027) and no dividend change; the name has fallen after 8 of 12 real release days, so a slight negative lean (p_up 45) on a 2.2% scale; the findings sum (-0.95) is several times the scaled number because it collects six small, partly priced negatives, while p_up carries the honest uncertainty.
bar: Company H1 plan (unchanged since 2026-05-13, reaffirmed 2026-07-27): sales 95,700m, OP 4,500m, ordinary 4,200m, NI 3,100m JPY; full year sales 198,000 / OP 12,000 / ordinary 11,200 / NI 8,200 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260727/140120260724599544.pdf). Street (kabuyoho consensus, one source, 2026-10-26): H1 ordinary 4,500, FY ordinary 12,275, FY sales 188,400, target price 2,710 (https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/report?bcode=5911, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=5911). The street bar is a single source, so findings resting on it are capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5% (baseline as_of 2026-10-26, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin (kabutan, week of 10/23): margin long 457.5k shares vs short 89.5k, ratio 5.11, down from 6.54 on 09/25 as margin shorts rose 31% while longs stayed ~flat; margin long ~4.5 days of median turnover (~100k shares/day). No options, no skew. Baseline priced_lean -0.19 (margin overhang -0.35, run-up +0.17).

findings.finding: No 業績予想の修正 has been filed ahead of this H1 print (TDnet list through 2026-10-26 shows only buyback status notices), whereas the company pre-released an H1 deviation on 10/22-10/25 in every year 2019-2024, including a voluntary +18% OP upgrade in 2023; in 2025, the one year without one, H1 landed within 0.4% of plan (OP 4,489 vs 4,500, ordinary 4,418 vs 4,400). So H1 most likely lands near the 4,200 ordinary plan, a few percent below the single-source street H1 of 4,500.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-29 H1 on plan with a sales-only FY trim: -1.00% next close; 2023-10-30 H1 after a pre-released upgrade: +1.31%; Q1 2026-07-27 missed the street Q1 (1,081 vs 1,750 ordinary): -2.06% (Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/5911.T?range=3y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: The street's quarterly H1 ordinary (4,500) still sits above the plan after a Q1 that missed its own Q1 number by 38%, so the consensus has not been marked to 'on plan'; if it had, the H1 consensus would read ~4,200. Small, because the inference rests on the absence of a filing and on one estimate source.
findings.independence: Q1 OP progress against the H1 OP plan is 25.2% this year vs 24.8% last year when H1 landed on plan (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260727/140120260724599544.pdf and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251029/140120251029580338.pdf) -- a different document pointing the same way (on plan).

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 12,000 / ordinary 11,200) is most likely held: the company held its FY2026 OP plan of 12,000 at H1 and Q3 and then delivered 13,500 (+12.5%), and at H1 2025 trimmed sales only; the street already sits above plan on profit (ordinary 12,275) and below plan on sales (188,400 vs 198,000), so a hold or a sales-only trim matches what the street has already done.
findings.why_not_priced: Not a mispricing claim: it records that the guidance line, the usual largest mover, is most likely a non-event, which is why the scale stays near the proxy. A cut would be new and is the downside tail; a raise the upside tail.
findings.independence: Revision record from the FY2026 H1 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251029/140120251029580338.pdf) and the FY2026 full-year actuals on kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=5911).

findings.finding: No new shareholder-return item is likely in this batch: the 2bn yen / 1m-share buyback decided 2026-07-27 runs to 2027-01-31 with 241,200 shares (~0.7bn) bought by 09-30, and the dividend (65+65=130, progressive, DOE target 3.5% already exceeded at ~3.9%) has been raised at Q3 (January) or the full-year print in recent years, not at H1; the largest positive H1 reaction in the record (+4.77% on 2024-10-29) came with a new buyback announced the same day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2024-10-29 H1 print + new buyback: +4.77% next close, +6.02% two days; 2025-07-28 and 2026-07-27 Q1 prints with new buybacks: -1.08% and -2.06%.
findings.why_not_priced: The ongoing programme is public, so this is mostly priced; it only removes the upside tail a retail holder might hope for at H1. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Dividend policy and DOE target in the FY2026 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260513/140120260512527113.pdf); disclosure history with dividend revisions dated in January (https://irbank.net/5911/ir).

findings.finding: This name sells its prints: measured on the actual release dates from the TDnet history (not the baseline's estimated dates), the next close was lower on 8 of 12 results releases since 2023-10 (median -0.92%), including every Q1/full-year print since 2024-05 except 2026-02-02 (+0.48%).
findings.why_not_priced: A reaction tendency, not information; if it were arbitraged the post-print drift would not be this one-sided. Twelve observations, so small.
findings.independence: Release dates from https://irbank.net/5911/ir (a different source from the price series).

findings.finding: Margin longs are crowded and margin shorts are building into the print: 信用買い残 457.5k shares (~4.5 days of turnover) against 売り残 89.5k, the ratio falling from 6.54 (09/25) to 5.11 (10/23) as shorts rose 31% with longs flat.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is the baseline's own margin_overhang component (-0.35). Only the build in margin shorts since late September is incremental, and a building short can also squeeze on a held plan; kept small.
findings.independence: Baseline positioning.margin_ratio 5.11 is the same datum (one source, counted once).

findings.finding: Bridges, the largest segment, are deteriorating underneath the BR Holdings consolidation: Q1 bridge OP fell 49% to 0.36bn 'from the state of works in hand', bridge orders fell 50.9% to 11.3bn, and the steel new-build backlog fell to 79.3bn from 90.5bn; system building (OP +41.7%, orders +31.4%) and engineering carried the quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2026-07-27 Q1 with this segment text: -2.06% next close (kabutan attributed it to the acquisition-cost extraordinary loss).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: public since July and inside a plan that already guides OP -11% on bridge weakness. Net of the rest of the company (system building and engineering up), it matters only if Q2 bridge margin is worse than the plan assumes.
findings.independence: FY2026 短信 outlook text guiding OP down on 'bridge business stagnation' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260513/140120260512527113.pdf).

baseline_tension: Agrees with the baseline's mild negative lean (-0.19, margin overhang) and adds little to it; the strongest positive the release could carry -- a held FY plan from a company that beat last year's plan by 12.5%, an H1 on plan against a Q1 the market sold, a buyback top-up, or a raised dividend at a 4.45% yield and 0.87x PBR -- was looked for: the buyback and dividend are unlikely in this batch, and a held plan is the base case, which is why p_up sits at 45 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on public 短信/進捗率 data): bridge-segment finding -0.2 -> -0.1 and H1-vs-street finding -0.3 -> -0.2, because both rest on the July 短信 anyone can read; p_up moved 42 -> 45.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): wrote the strongest possible positive into baseline_tension and confirmed it was searched for; trimmed the reaction-history finding -0.4 -> -0.3 and the margin finding -0.2 -> -0.15 as both largely restate the baseline's lean.
Open question 3 (pre-released revision kills the event): no revision was pre-released here, so the event stands; abs_move_pct left at 2.2.
